title: Updating the random index
statement: For any register state and any natural number $z$, replacing its random-index field $nx$ by $z$ gives a register-value vector equal to the vector obtained by replacing coordinate $8$ of the original vector by $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $8$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $8$th coordinate to $z$.
